contract: Read one selected programme through AnyReader and Blocking::next_event, retaining each AnyOther::MpegTs carrier and control event in delivery order.
Compare carrier bytes, source positions, PID, payload start and continuity counter against ITU-T H.222.0 (08/2023) §§2.4.3.2–2.4.3.5. The M2TS arrival prefix remains part of the physical carrier.

Compare PID continuity, CRC-checked PSI and route selection against §§2.4.3.3, 2.4.4.2–2.4.4.6, 2.4.4.9–2.4.4.10 and Annex A. Exercise a PMT version wrap that retypes a PID. The configuration epoch follows SourceEpochs::configuration.

Compare the distinct PES headers and their exact payloads and elementary offsets under §§2.4.3.6–2.4.3.7. Exercise a PES spread across multiple carriers, two PES packets containing one AAC unit, PTS and DTS, and clean EOF. The facade-mpegts gate compares the resulting access units separately.
